defects.claim: The receipts digest still shows the per-run cost when key_source is unknown or empty. The issue says the cost line appears only when key_source is the tenant's own key.
defects.evidence: The check is `if exec.KeySource != memory.KeySourcePlatform {`, so any value other than platform passes. The store writes empty key sources as `unknown` (`COALESCE(NULLIF(key_source, ''), 'unknown')` at internal/memory/store.go:866). This repeats the founder-tenant memory pitfall: that tenant records key_source=unknown on every execution, so the platform-key tenant would still see $ costs in the Telegram digest. BuildStructured gets this right with `run.KeySource == memory.KeySourceOwn` (internal/briefs/structured.go:78), so the two outputs disagree.

defects.claim: The day total in the digest has the same problem. It hides the total only when a row is `platform`, so an all-`unknown` day still prints the $ total.
defects.evidence: `if exec.KeySource == memory.KeySourcePlatform { return total }`. TestFormatReceiptLine_PlatformKeyOmitsCost (internal/briefs/structured_test.go) only tests own and platform. It has no unknown case, so it never exercises this path.

defects.claim: Structured briefs are saved only as a side effect of the daily-brief scheduler. A tenant with `daily_brief` disabled or no channels gets nothing stored, and GET /api/v1/briefs/latest returns 404 for good.
defects.evidence: `s.storeStructured(brief.Period)` is called only inside runBriefWithResults. The scheduler is built only in the daily_brief block at cmd/pilot/main.go:4009.

defects.claim: Nothing in production calls SetPoolSource, so the pool section is always null. This is acceptable because nothing in the daemon reads allowance usage today, but the section can never be filled.
defects.evidence: A grep for SetPoolSource finds only generator.go:23 and structured_test.go:282.

defects.claim: `make lint` fails in the PR evidence with 3 staticcheck SA4023 findings. They are in cmd/pilot/tunnel.go, which this diff does not touch, so the failure was already there.
defects.evidence: The pasted output shows "3 issues: * staticcheck: 3 … make: *** [Makefile:94: lint] Error 1".

defects.claim: The day total keeps the dollar sum when the rows are a mix of own and unknown keys. Because unknown is only excluded when the key is literally `platform`, the total can include cost from runs the tenant is not billed for. evidence: `if exec.KeySource == memory.KeySourcePlatform { return total }`

The project filter is applied to executions but not to review items. `LoadPendingApprovals` returns approvals from every project, so a brief filtered to some projects lists other projects' items under review_needed. evidence: internal/memory/approval_store.go:90 `FROM approval_pending` / `ORDER BY created_at ASC` has no project clause.

The failed section is not de-duplicated. A task that failed twice and never shipped appears twice. evidence: `b.Failed = append(b.Failed, FailedRun{` runs once per failed row; only `delivered[e.TaskID]` is checked.

`SetPoolSource` is never called outside tests, so the pool section is always null in production. This fits the issue's "when the daemon knows it", because no allowance reader exists in the daemon (a grep for allowance/PercentUsed finds only comments and the new code).

`make lint` fails with 3 staticcheck SA4023 errors in cmd/pilot/tunnel.go, which this PR does not change. So the "`make lint` passes" acceptance bullet is not met, but the failure is pre-existing in package cmd/pilot.
